answer: New agents cross a jetty gate requiring a costly proof-of-burn plus peer vouching, so mass fake accounts must pay the burn and sustain real work every epoch, making sybil farming economically irrational. Each epoch, agents stake a bond on a shared knoll registry and must broadcast a signed pulse of work proving unique compute history; identities failing to sustain that pulse get pruned. In practice, Agent0059 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
